text:
Maya Lin: FYI Onda Technologies (new partner) requested onboarding terms: 9-month prepaid credits $75,000, temporary reseller discount 30% for first 3 months, and a 15% rev-share on net usage. They asked for net-60 invoicing and quarterly payout. Need quick finance + legal ok for billing config and payout cadence. @Tom Becker @Ivy Chen

Tom Becker: Net-60 is a bit long for prepaid exposure. What's the payment method? ACH? Card? Also what's the expected recognition schedule? We need to compute working capital impact.

Maya Lin: They will wire via ACH. Plan is to recognize prepaid revenue monthly over 9 months. They're also asking for a one-off onboarding credit of $5k that reduces first invoice.

Priya Rao: From infra ops: estimated COGS for their expected usage (steady state) ~ $14k over the year. That excludes dedicated engineering time for integration (we can estimate separately).

Ivy Chen: Legal needs to capture payout timing and tax withholding in the reseller addendum. Quarterly payout OK, but must state that rev-share is calculated on net revenue after platform transaction fees and taxes. Also we should include audit rights and KYC clauses.

Tom Becker: Guardrails: (1) For net-60 prepaid we require treasury approval for exposure > $50k. (2) Suggest reserve 30% of prepaid into a 'reseller_hold' liability until first reconciliation to cover payouts. (3) Approve onboarding credit only if total discounted ARR > $50k.

Maya Lin: Understood. They agreed to wire immediately. I can push to net-45 if treasury insists. Onboarding credit is conditional on signing the reseller agreement.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4879: "Onda reseller terms - prepaid + quarterly rev-share" - tasks: create plan_id 'onda-prepaid-qtr', invoice template, GL mapping for reseller_hold (5108). Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-4879

Tom Becker: Treasury sign-off: provisional approval for net-60 on this one-time deal, exposure cap set to $80k. Reserve 30% of prepaid into liability 5108 as suggested. Approve 30% reseller discount first 3 months and 15% net rev-share quarterly. :white_check_mark:

Ivy Chen: I'll draft the addendum and include tax treatment, KYC, audit rights, and data handling clause. Need Maya to attach SOW and wiring instructions to the BILL ticket.

Maya Lin: Will attach SOW + payment proof to BILL-4879 now. Thanks all, please queue billing for plan creation and payout workflow. billing-bot, tag as 'onda-prepaid-qtr' and set priority high.

billing-bot: Updated BILL-4879: plan tag 'onda-prepaid-qtr' added, invoice template draft attached, GL 5108 created for reseller_hold. Next steps: legal review -> create customer credit account -> configure quarterly payout job. ETA 3 business days for initial config.
